newsitem.title: USA: Chemical Financ'l sets 5 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Chemical Financ'l sets 5 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Chemical Financial Corp said on Monday its board of directors has declared a five percent stock dividend, as well as a $0.20 a share cash dividend.
The company also said it plans to establish a $0.21 a share quarterly dividend in 1997.
The stock dividend will be paid December 30 to shareholders of record December 17.
The fourth quarter cash dividend will be paid December 12 to shareholders of record December 2.

The proposed increase in cash dividends, coupled with the increased number of shares outstanding following the five percent stock dividend, will result in a 10.25 percent overall increase in cash dividends to be paid in 1997, Chemical, a $1.68 billion asset bank holding company said.
Chemcial shares were down 1/4 at 36-1/2 Monday.
